title: An independent proof of the even-dimensional S-matrix inequality
summary: Harwit and Sloane conjectured that every nonsingular entrywise-nonnegative matrix $A\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$ satisfies $\|A^{-1}\|_F\ge 2n(n+1)^{-1}\|A\|_{\max}^{-1}$, with equality precisely for positive multiples of $S$-matrices. Zhang has given a complete proof of this conjecture by a centered pseudoinverse and spectral variance method. We present an independently obtained, structurally different proof of the strict even-dimensional inequality.
